Parcel Panic: Conveyor Mayhem for **Windows 11, 64-bit**.

1. Download **ParcelPanic-Windows-x64.zip** below.
2. Extract the whole ZIP, then open **ParcelPanic/ParcelPanic.exe**.
3. Keep the **assets** folder beside the EXE. No compiler or editor is needed to play.

Includes all four levels, Tomorrow fonts, a slightly larger 1360 × 765 window, clearer queue labels, parcel hover cards and F1–F3 demos with sample data. F4 skips to the next level; Shift+F4 goes back.

The ZIP includes the fonts, their license and a short controls guide. GitHub's separate **Source code** downloads contain the project files rather than the playable game.

Built on Windows through GitHub Actions. Gameplay and scaled mouse controls were checked in the cloud; Windows 11 playtesting and display-scaling feedback are welcome.
